sloka: पित्र्याणि ब्रह्मरत्नानि यज्ञान्परमदुस्तरान् ।चकार रामो धर्मात्मा पितऽन्देवान्विवर्धयन् ।। ७.९९.१९ ॥
transliteration: pitryāṇi brahmaratnāni yajñānparamadustarān ।cakāra rāmo dharmātmā pita'ndevānvivardhayan ।। 7.99.19 ॥

translations.english: The righteous-souled Rama performed ancestral rites, excellent Vedic rituals, and extremely difficult sacrifices, thereby causing his ancestors and the gods to prosper.
